# PK INDUSTRIES

> Manufacturer, exporter and supplier of steel melting shop (SMS) consumables and
> continuous casting machine (CCM) raw materials, based in Adityapur, Jamshedpur,
> Jharkhand, India. Five product lines: casting powder (mould flux), nozzle filling
> compound, refractory castable, refractory mortar, ladle covering compound (Radex),
> and disposable thermocouple tips and samplers.

PK INDUSTRIES supplies steel producers across India and exports internationally.
Grades are formulated to the customer's steel chemistry, casting route, casting speed
and mould or ladle dimensions rather than sold as fixed catalogue items. Being located
inside the Jamshedpur steel cluster shortens delivery lead times to producers across
Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Bihar.

- Location: Adityapur, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 832109, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94313 42715
- Email: info@pkindustries.net
- Coverage: PAN India supply and exports

## Products

- [Casting Powder](https://pkindustries.net/casting-powder.html): Continuous casting mould flux for billet, bloom and slab routes. Melts into a liquid slag film that lubricates the mould-shell gap, controls horizontal heat transfer, insulates the meniscus and absorbs non-metallic inclusions.
- [Nozzle Filling Compound](https://pkindustries.net/nozzle-filling-compound.html): Free-opening compound packed into the ladle nozzle before tapping. Resists sintering at ladle temperatures so the slide gate opens under gravity without oxygen lancing.
- [Refractory Castable](https://pkindustries.net/castable.html): Monolithic refractory for furnace linings, ladle linings, launders and high-wear zones. Cast, pumped or gunned into place to form a jointless lining.
- [Refractory Mortar](https://pkindustries.net/mortar.html): Dry-blend bonding mortar for refractory jointing, local patching and furnace maintenance. Supplied in 25 kg and 50 kg bags, up to 6 months shelf life in dry storage.
- [Ladle Covering Compound (Radex)](https://pkindustries.net/ladle-covering-compound-radex.html): Low-density insulating powder spread over molten steel in the ladle to cut radiative heat loss and limit reoxidation during holding and casting.
- [Disposable Thermocouple Tips & Samplers](https://pkindustries.net/thermocouple-tips-samplers.html): Single-use immersion probes giving bath temperature in 3-5 seconds (Types S and R to 1650 C, Type B to 1750 C, tolerance +/- 5 C, 602/604 contact blocks, paper tubes 300-1800 mm), plus disposable samplers for drawing molten steel samples for analysis. Used at the furnace, ladle and tundish.

## Terminology notes

Several products are known by more than one name in the industry, and these refer to
the same material:

- "Casting powder", "mould powder" and "mould flux" are the same product. "Casting
  powder" and "mould powder" are the usual shop-floor terms in India; "mould flux" is
  more common in academic and European literature.
- "Ladle covering compound", "Radex" and "ladle insulating powder" are used
  interchangeably in Indian steel plants. Radex is a trade name.
- "NFC" is the standard abbreviation for nozzle filling compound.
- "SMS consumables" means steel melting shop consumables; "CCM raw material" refers to
  continuous casting machine inputs.
- "Free opening" means a ladle opening under gravity when the slide gate is actuated,
  without oxygen lancing to clear the nozzle.
